primary.handling_notes: Continuous segments are converted to B/I tags using offset_mapping. Discontinuous spans are split into constituent segments and tagged sequentially. Overlapping spans resolve to B-PHENOTYPE at segment boundaries and I-PHENOTYPE inside. Original character spans preserved in raw_spans column.
